_note: Per-file .py ceiling (150). The ratchet (scripts/size_ratchet.py) governs production source (core/api/protocol) and test INFRASTRUCTURE (conftest, fakes, fake_*); the test SUITES (test_*.py, append-only case collections) are out of scope. The allowlist holds reviewed, pre-existing exceptions FROZEN at their current count: a listed file may not grow, and a shrink must be banked by lowering its number (the ratchet click). A new or grown file over the ceiling fails: split it by concern, do not allowlist your own bloat. These four predate the ADR-0037 actuation move and are next in line to split by concern.
